target.title: fix(ui): prevent New Session input loss during creation
target.body:
Closes #105632

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users starting a session in the Control UI could edit the message or target controls while creation was pending, even though the in-flight request had already captured the earlier draft. Successful navigation then silently discarded those accepted late edits.

## Why This Change Was Made

Treat session creation as one atomic submitted draft. While `sessions.create` is pending, the New Session page closes open pickers and locks the message, agent/folder/run-target controls, suggestions, and recent-session actions; if creation fails, the same draft becomes editable and retryable again.

## User Impact

New Session no longer presents controls whose changes cannot affect the pending request. Users either reach the session created from the exact visible submitted draft or recover the unchanged draft after a failure.

## Evidence

- Real exact-head OpenAI-backed Gateway proof: submitted message preserved; message and target controls locked; late message/target interactions rejected; `runStarted: true`; navigation reached the returned session; no page or console errors; QA session/transcript deleted.
- Focused Blacksmith Testbox E2E: `corepack pnpm test ui/src/e2e/new-session-page.e2e.test.ts` — 6/6 passed on `tbx_01kxc1cdhtnsscbzzyk1fnax46`.
- Changed gate: `corepack pnpm check:changed` — UI/core-test type checks, changed-file lint/format, docs/changelog checks all passed on the same Testbox.
- Full production build: `corepack pnpm build` passed on the same Testbox.
- Local production UI build: `node scripts/ui.js build` passed.
- Fresh exact-head autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings; patch correctness confidence 0.91.
- Source-blind behavior-validator fixture passed compliance review but its single run blocked on an exact `Start session` locator timeout before it could grade the clauses; it reported no page or console errors. The late session it created was deleted, and the isolated QA profile was verified at zero dashboard sessions.
